name: ollama
description: Local inference runtime. Models run on-device, zero cost, zero latency to external APIs.

name: anthropic
description: Claude models via Anthropic API. Requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

name: openai
description: GPT models via OpenAI API. Requires OPENAI_API_KEY.

name: embedded-llama
description: In-process llama.cpp runtime. Serves many models across capabilities (chat + embed) on-device with no external daemon. Model bytes resolve via the sensei registry: managed dir first, then a read-through view of the local Ollama cache. Active when the daemon is built with embedded-llama-cpp and the model resolves.

name: nvidia
description: NVIDIA NIM — OpenAI-compatible hosted inference. Requires NVIDIA_API_KEY.
